channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Alex Caruso | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Alex Caruso from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: LeBron James on Josh Hart, Alex Caruso
item.description:
LeBron James:

“San Antonio, they're a team that doesn't have ego. They have their personal beliefs on what they can bring to the table. We all do, we're all competitors, but that team is egoless. It's big time to see Josh (Hart) kind of growing to the player that he's in. We always talk about Alex Caruso a lot. It's those certain guys that you can plug into any franchise, any team, and they're going to win because those guys just make winning plays.”

LeBron James on Josh Hart, Alex Caruso, Jun 9, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Donovan Mitchell on Alex Caruso
item.description:
Cavaliers guard Donovan Mitchell said.

“Not comparing the players, but you see a similar situation in the other series. And with [Alex] Caruso [Oklahoma City Thunder guard], they're guarding him kind of the same way. So I'm not saying he's him or whatever or vice versa, but you just got to adjust, and we'll look at the film and figure out ways to adjust.”

Donovan Mitchell on Alex Caruso, May 22, 2026. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Billy Donovan on Alex Caruso, Isaac Okoro
item.description:
Donovan explained on Friday.

“They don’t need to be waiting to get the ball back in their hands. There’s other things they can be doing to impact the game. (Former Bull Alex) Caruso did it for us at a really high level, and I think Isaac (Okoro) will do it for us, but I think for our guys being young too, they have to understand that we don’t have a lot of guys that can play with the ball in their hands and that can make plays, be these elite, high-level scorers.“So for them to carve out a niche in the NBA and have a long career, they’ve really got to understand that they really got to embrace their 95% that they don’t have the ball in their hands in some way.”

Billy Donovan on Alex Caruso, Isaac Okoro, Oct 25, 2025. Source: Chicago Sun-Times.

item.title: Sam Presti on Alex Caruso, Isaiah Hartenstein
item.description:
Presti on Caruso and Hartenstein:

“Their personalities were so well suited for this particular team at this particular team. I don't know if that'll ever happen that we find two elite role players that are happy being role players that are tailor made for our program.”

Sam Presti on Alex Caruso, Isaiah Hartenstein, Jun 30, 2025. Source: Twitter @BrandonRahbar.

item.title: Brooks Barnhizer on Alex Caruso, Luguentz Dort
item.description:
Brandon Rahbar:Brooks Barnhizer on players he’s looking forward to work with:

“Caruso and Dort, guys who are kind of similar to my path. If I can be fit from that same cloth one day…”

Brooks Barnhizer on Alex Caruso, Luguentz Dort, Jun 28, 2025. Source: Twitter @BrandonRahbar.

item.title: Mark Daigneault on Alex Caruso
item.description:
Mark Daigneault on Alex Caruso’s leadership:

“He’s a very prominent voice. He’s extroverted as a competitor.. But it’s a pretty flat thing. That’s unique about our team. We get a lot of leadership from a lot of different people. I think that’s what makes our team function the way it does: everybody’s got their fingerprints on it.”

Mark Daigneault on Alex Caruso, Jun 19, 2025. Source: Twitter @BrandonRahbar.

item.title: Draymond Green on Alex Caruso
item.description:
“If I'm an opposing coach, I'm saying 'Caruso's been in this moment, he's shown us over and over again he can deliver in this moment, I'm going to make him so important to our game plan,”

Draymond Green on Alex Caruso, Jun 9, 2025. Source: NBC Sports Bay Area.

item.title: Draymond Green on Alex Caruso
item.description:
and explained why veteran guard Alex Caruso, not young center Chet Holmgren, is the Thunder's third-most-important player behind his undisputed No. 1 and No. 2 options Shai Gilgeous-Alexander and Jalen Williams.

“When I look at this OKC team, I actually think the third-most-important player is Alex Caruso .... I think Caruso is so important to what they do and I feel like you never game plan for him,”

Draymond Green on Alex Caruso, Jun 9, 2025. Source: NBC Sports Bay Area.

item.title: LeBron James on Julius Randle, Giannis Antetokounmpo, Jamal Murray, Alex Caruso
item.description:
LeBron James:

“And then (the Thunder) come off the bench with one of my favorite teammates of all time, Alex Caruso, who is like the dog. He's the ultimate Swiss Army knife. We've literally seen him guard Giannis. We've seen him guard the Joker. You know, we've seen him guard Ant, we've seen him guard Julius Randle, we've seen him guard Jamal Murray throughout this whole postseason.”

LeBron James on Julius Randle, Giannis Antetokounmpo, Jamal Murray, Alex Caruso, Jun 4, 2025. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Mark Daigneault on Nikola Jokic, Alex Caruso
item.description:
Brandon Rahbar:Mark Daigneault on Alex Caruso defending Jokic:

“The volume of it today was a result of how effective it was. He did an unbelievable job…If you’re putting a 6’5 guard on a player like that, you need relentless help. It truly is team defense…”

Mark Daigneault on Nikola Jokic, Alex Caruso, May 18, 2025. Source: Twitter @BrandonRahbar.

item.title: Mark Daigneault on Alex Caruso
item.description:
Brandon Rahbar:Mark Daigneault on Alex Caruso:

“He’s just a menace. He’s in the middle of everything. They had one stretch where they didn’t cross half court just cause of him. He’s out there messing the game up for everybody.. except for us.”

Mark Daigneault on Alex Caruso, Jan 23, 2025. Source: Twitter @BrandonRahbar.

item.title: Cason Wallace on Alex Caruso, Luguentz Dort
item.description:
Joel Lorenzi:Cason Wallace on the lineups he shares with Alex Caruso and Lu Dort:

“I like the way we all fly around and play off each other. We kinda have the same feel and instincts on the defensive end,so it makes it easier to read each other.”

Cason Wallace on Alex Caruso, Luguentz Dort, Oct 19, 2024. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Sam Presti on Alex Caruso
item.description:
Joel Lorenzi:Sam Presti on Alex Caruso being extension eligible in December:

“I think it’s clear that he fits a lot of the criteria and characteristics we want here.”

Sam Presti on Alex Caruso, Sep 25, 2024. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Sam Presti on Alex Caruso, Isaiah Hartenstein
item.description:
“This year we have two significant additions in Isaiah Hartenstein and Alex Caruso.”

Sam Presti on Alex Caruso, Isaiah Hartenstein, Sep 25, 2024. Source: Twitter @BrandonRahbar.

item.title: Donovan Mitchell on Alex Caruso
item.description:
(via Million Dollaz Worth of Game):Mitchell:

“I would say it’s probably gon’ be Minnesota or OKC. I think Minnesota, they some dogs. I think they figured it out too about themselves. They made some trades and made some different acquisitions and all that, but they figured it out. OKC adding Alex Caruso, I don’t think people really understand what that does for that lineup. You’ve already got [Cason] Wallace over there, you’ve got Lu Dort, Shai [Gilgeous-Alexander]’s not a bad defender himself. You add Alex Caruso to that lineup.”

Donovan Mitchell on Alex Caruso, Aug 6, 2024. Source: TalkBasket.

item.title: Mark Daigneault on Alex Caruso
item.description:
Mark Daigneault on Alex Caruso:

“We have a locker room that has an existing ethos. They’re high level professionals. They’re willing to put each other’s success first. They root for each other.”

Mark Daigneault on Alex Caruso, Jun 29, 2024. Source: Twitter @BrandonRahbar.

item.title: Sam Presti on Alex Caruso
item.description:
Joel Lorenzi:Sam Presti on his impressions of Alex Caruso long ago:

“I remember writing a report on him, and it was like, this guy could probably kick a 50-yard field goal, catch a deep fly ball, throw a football 70 yards, and also kick somebody’s ass in cards. He’s a universal competitor.”

Sam Presti on Alex Caruso, Jun 21, 2024. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Sam Presti on Mark Daigneault, Alex Caruso
item.description:
Clemente Almanza:Sam Presti on Mark Daigneault's relationship with Alex Caruso:

“We're always talking. We talk all the time about the team. About things we value and things we feel like are on our plate... I think it's a great thing those guys have come full circle in their careers to get to this point.”

Sam Presti on Mark Daigneault, Alex Caruso, Jun 21, 2024. Source: Twitter @CAlmanza1007.

item.title: Billy Donovan on DeMar DeRozan, Alex Caruso
item.description:
Julia Poe:Billy Donovan on how he valued the current Bulls players going into the trade deadline:

“I think Alex Caruso is one of the most valuable players in the NBA.I think you need to get a haul for him. Those players like DeMar DeRozan, like Alex Caruso just don't grow on trees.”

Billy Donovan on DeMar DeRozan, Alex Caruso, Feb 8, 2024. Source: Twitter @byjuliapoe.

item.title: Kevin Durant on Alex Caruso
item.description:
Kevin Durant on Alex Caruso:

“He’s a phenomenal player. I don’t even want to call him a role player. But just a guy that you can plug with any lineup and he’s going to make the right reads, the right plays on the defensive and offensive side.”

Kevin Durant on Alex Caruso, Nov 9, 2023. Source: Twitter @DarnellMayberry.

item.title: Patrick Williams on Alex Caruso
item.description:
I thought one thing was interesting about Williams that I heard from an executive who told HoopsHype,

“In my opinion, they’ve held onto Pat Williams too long and devalued him. If they want to shake up their team, they can get a decent return on Caruso.”

Patrick Williams on Alex Caruso, Jan 12, 2023. Source: HoopsHype.

item.title: Zach LaVine on Grayson Allen, Alex Caruso
item.description:
KC Johnson:Zach LaVine on Grayson Allen's big games after what happened during regular season with Alex Caruso:

“You gotta give him credit. He's hitting shots. Obviously, we know what happened. At the end of the day, it's basketball.”

Zach LaVine on Grayson Allen, Alex Caruso, Apr 24, 2022. Source: Twitter @KCJHoop.

item.title: Tristan Thompson on Grayson Allen, Alex Caruso
item.description:
Tristan Thompson on Grayson Allen returning to United Center after injuring Alex Caruso earlier in season:

“Shit. Take one of my dawgs out like that, we going to have issues. We got to set the tone.”

Tristan Thompson on Grayson Allen, Alex Caruso, Mar 4, 2022. Source: Twitter.

item.title: DeMar DeRozan on Alex Caruso
item.description:
Mark Medina:DeMar DeRozan on Alex Caruso:

“He's one of the highest IQ players I've played with since I've been in the game. Just to have somebody with that natural IQ out there on the court, it's going to make things so much easier for you offensively and defensively.”

DeMar DeRozan on Alex Caruso, Nov 15, 2021. Source: Twitter @MarkG_Medina.

item.title: Frank Vogel on Alex Caruso
item.description:
Frank Vogel on Alex Caruso:

“How do you not love a guy that plays as hard as Alex does?”

Frank Vogel on Alex Caruso, Nov 15, 2021. Source: Twitter @RyanWardLA.

item.title: Frank Vogel on Alex Caruso
item.description:
Melissa Rohlin:Frank Vogel on Alex Caruso:

“I think his winning habits and winning DNA is a big part of their resurgence.”

Frank Vogel on Alex Caruso, Nov 15, 2021. Source: Twitter @melissarohlin.

item.title: Anthony Davis on Alex Caruso
item.description:
Mike Trudell:Davis on the return of @Alex Caruso tomorrow vs. Chicago:

“It’s going to be fun playing against AC again … all the stuff he brought to (our championship team).He was a big part of what we did here.”

Anthony Davis on Alex Caruso, Nov 14, 2021. Source: Twitter @LakersReporter.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Alex Caruso
item.description:
Rob Schaefer:Steve Kerr on Alex Caruso:

“He’s great. I was really happy to see him go to the Eastern Conference”

Steve Kerr on Alex Caruso, Nov 12, 2021. Source: Twitter @rob_schaef.

item.title: Rob Pelinka on Alex Caruso
item.description:
“We made an aggressive attempt to re-sign Alex Caruso, and we made an aggressive attempt to keep Talen,”

Rob Pelinka on Alex Caruso, Sep 24, 2021. Source: Silverscreenandroll.com.

item.title: Kyle Kuzma on Kentavious Caldwell-Pope, Jamal Murray, Alex Caruso
item.description:
“Look at Denver with Murray, even looking at the Heat this year how many injuries they had, along with us, too. Having AD out, Bron out, [Kentavious Caldwell-Pope] out a few games, [Alex] Caruso out a few games, a lot of people missed games, and I contribute that to the bubble.”

Kyle Kuzma on Kentavious Caldwell-Pope, Jamal Murray, Alex Caruso, Jul 8, 2021. Source: Bleacher Report.
